$$B_R+F_R+A_+\le D.$$

$$B_R+F_R+A_++G_b
\le\Lambda+F_U+F_R.$$

&\le \Lambda+B_U+F_U\\
&\le \Lambda+2B_{11}.
\end{aligned}$$
